name: app-slip
description: A phone-app purchase slip (paper): title, item row, amount, a shiny haldi 'gold' badge, and a blue-ballpoint arrow from the badge to a handwritten note (e.g. 'SEBI?'). Params: title (default 'Payment successful'), item, amount (number, Indian grouping), badge (text in the gold badge, default '24K'; the badge is a round coin for short text and a pill that grows, with type shrinking for long text such as 'LAST CHANCE'), note (pen note, default 'SEBI?'), noteAt = seconds after the cut the arrow + note draw (default 0.8), x/y = top-left, width (default 860). Slip is tossed in on the cut frame; only the pen arrow and note draw later.
